label: M1_mode2_lucky_classic_7_dominant
_note: M1 mode 2 target v3 (2026-04-24) — TDD archetype rebuild. Dropped per_reel_symbol_targets (was fabricated pattern). Physical layout locked to Hot Roll 22-stop reel; this target is RTP/hit/bucket only. See reel_strips.json._archetype.
2026-04-22 v3 (classic overhaul): previous v2 target was mid-heavy (44% of RTP in 10-50× bucket), which departs from classic 3-reel norms.

Industry research (see commit message): classic 1-line slots are 7-DOMINATED. Red White & Blue has 50% of RTP from Sevens; Blazing Sevens has 68.8%. Compressing the 7 family to 0.003% (v2 state) is ~100× below industry norm — Sevens should hit ~0.3-1% per line and contribute the 'big wins' feel.
Mode 2 is the 'lucky mode' — same paytable/rules as mode 1, different reel weights, targeted at ~290% RTP / 27-28% hit. Classic-style means 'more Sevens more often' (not 'more mid-range wins').
Design budget — 294% RTP, ~27.67% hit:
ge1_lt5 (Cherry):              17.0%   → 18.7pp (6% of RTP)   ← Cherry staple, scaled up for hit rate
ge5_lt10 (mixed 3-Bar 5×):      5.5%   → 27.5pp (9% of RTP)
ge50_lt100 (no pays):           0      → 0pp
ge100_lt200 (3 Seven1 100×):    1.1%   → 110pp (37% of RTP) ← 7 backbone scaled
ge200_lt500 (Seven2 + wilds):   0.27%  → 81pp (28% of RTP)  ← wild-sevens top tier
sum hit = 27.67%, sum RTP = 294.5pp
RTP contribution shares (classic 7-heavy target):
Low (1-10×):       46pp (16%)  — Cherry + mixed Bar (keeps player engaged between 7 hits)
Mid (10-50×):      57pp (19%)  — 3-Bar family (routine wins)
**High (100-500×):191pp (65%)** — Sevens + wild-Sevens, the 'lucky' boom-bust engine
Top (500+): 0 (rtp_excluded grand jackpots)
Seven family total hit rate ≈ 1.37% (1 in 73 spins) — aligns with Blazing Sevens 1.2% all-7-combos benchmark. Each seven hit pays 100-360×, creating real excitement events every ~70 spins.

CV expected ~ 5.5 (higher than v2's 4.08 but lower than a pure-jackpot machine). This trades smoothness for excitement — the user brief was 'player emotional experience also matters', and classic slots know: the memory of the big 7 hit is what keeps players playing.
